topic: SBI multi-rail relationships across Ripple/XRPL and Circle/Arc

related_immutable_artifact.preservation: The existing preimage-bound institutional network artifact remains unchanged; this addendum is append-only.

sources.excerpt: Arc public mainnet launch 2026-09-16. Founding validator cohort includes SBI Group. SBI Chairman Yoshitaka Kitao says SBI will contribute to Arc operation and governance; he also says SBI VC Trade began distributing USDC in March 2025 and SBI will leverage USDC and JPYSC in its SBI APAC Digital Economic Zone initiative.
sources.hash_scope: SHA-256 of the normalized stored excerpt, not complete source-page bytes.
limits: Issuer announcement confirms founding-cohort status and stated operational/governance role, not independent validator uptime, stake weight, or transaction share.
Arc is Circle's separate public Layer 1 network, not XRPL.

sources.original_title: Circle社によるARC Tokenプレセールへの参加に関するお知らせ
sources.excerpt: SBI Holdings 2026-05-12 announcement: through a consolidated subsidiary, participated in Circle's ARC Token presale. The release cites Circle's announcement that a consortium of major investors raised USD 222 million. No SBI-specific allocation, token quantity, or settlement amount disclosed.
sources.hash_scope: SHA-256 of the normalized stored excerpt, not complete source-page bytes.
limits: The USD 222M figure is a consortium total, not SBI's individual investment.
SBI's allocation, token quantity, and settlement amount are not disclosed.

sources.excerpt: Circle Form 10-Q for period ended 2026-09-30: Q2 2026 institutional ARC token purchase agreements for 807.5 million tokens at USD 0.30 each; aggregate gross proceeds approximately USD 242.2 million; USD 181.8 million recognized as revenue, remainder deferred; IDG-affiliated purchaser's USD 25 million included in aggregate, not additional. Filing does not identify SBI.
sources.hash_scope: SHA-256 of the normalized stored excerpt, not complete filing bytes.
limits: The filing does not identify SBI as a purchaser or disclose an SBI-specific allocation.
The aggregate institutional purchase-agreement proceeds do not establish cash paid by any one investor.

relationship_updates.relationship: Founding validator cohort member at Arc's 2026-09-16 public-mainnet launch; SBI Chairman Yoshitaka Kitao stated SBI would contribute to Arc operation and governance.
limits: No independent validator telemetry, stake weight, uptime, or transaction share is disclosed.
Arc is not XRPL; this relationship is not an XRP validator or XRP demand signal.

relationship_updates.relationship: SBI Holdings announced participation through a consolidated subsidiary in the ARC Token presale.
limits: Do not attribute the consortium total to SBI.
ARC is a Circle Arc network token, not XRP or an XRPL asset.
The May 12 SBI release cites a $222M consortium total; the later Q3 SEC filing reports $242.2M in aggregate institutional purchase agreements entered during Q2.
The records do not identify the same investor cohort or explain the $20.2M difference.
The Q3 filing's $242.2M aggregate is not evidence that SBI invested $242.2M or any specific amount.
Neither disclosure establishes an XRP purchase, XRPL investment, or XRP spot demand.

network_conclusion.sbi_multi_rail_strategy: Primary disclosures show SBI's relationships span Ripple/XRPL-related businesses and Circle/Arc/USDC infrastructure. The evidence supports a multi-rail strategy, not exclusive alignment with either network.
network_conclusion.coinbase_circle: Coinbase and Circle have a documented equity and USDC distribution/revenue-sharing relationship; the existing institutional network artifact contains the dated terms and Q3 2026 update.
network_conclusion.sbi_coinbase: No direct SBI-Coinbase agreement is established in the reviewed primary sources; their connection is indirect through Circle/USDC ecosystem participation.
network_conclusion.circle_ripple: No direct Circle-Ripple partnership is established by the reviewed sources; shared BNY services do not prove a direct partnership.
network_conclusion.xrp_demand: Validator status, ARC presale participation, USDC/JPYSC distribution, and RLUSD distribution do not establish XRP purchases or XRPL payment volume.

forecast_status.reason: Corporate network relationships and token-presale participation are context, not synchronized XRP demand features or demonstrated out-of-sample predictive signals.
